title: Pro Metronome Session Tempo Leaderboard
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prometronome:session tempo_bpm=*
| stats sum(tempo_bpm) as total_value, avg(tempo_bpm) as avg_value by exercise_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks exercise name values by total and average tempo across Pro Metronome session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `tempo_bpm` values for each Pro Metronome session event and review total and average tempo by exercise name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total tempo.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which exercise name shows the biggest tempo numbers in your Pro Metronome session data.
